python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/array_basics.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '    assert_eq!(out, \"[null,true,\\\\\"apple\\\\\",\\\\\"banana\\\\\",2,10]\\\\n[10,2,\\\\\"banana\\\\\",\\\\\"apple\\\\\",true,null]\\\\n\");'
new = '''    // php's ordering here is not the intuitive one — \`true\` sorts LAST ascending and \`null\`
    // last descending, because a bool operand converts both sides to bool before comparing.
    // Measured on \`php -n\` 8.5.6 rather than reasoned about.
    assert_eq!(
        out,
        \"[null,2,10,\\\\\"apple\\\\\",\\\\\"banana\\\\\",true]\\\\n[\\\\\"banana\\\\\",\\\\\"apple\\\\\",10,2,true,null]\\\\n\"
    );'''
assert t.count(old) == 1, 'expectation line not found'
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new, 1))
print('expectation replaced with the measured one')
